snippet.title: Sonic Battle R: SAGE 2025 Trailer
snippet.description:
Sonic Battle R  coming with a new update to expand it roster of stages to over 60+, more characters to join the party, and all new systems and mechanics to explore, master (and dodge in some cases. Sage 2025 will be our biggest update yet since version 3 release and we hope you enjoy the game. 
6 new characters and a few alternate costume for existing characters, 9 new stages, and collectibles in all the new and old stages to find.

Sonic Battle R Discord: https://discord.gg/cefUfnuMFN
Download: https://gamejolt.com/games/SonicBattleR/425118
